paragraphs: Travel Guide Package Recommendation System
ABSTRACT

The recent past showed a greater interest in recommender techniques. Now-adays there are many travel packages existing from different websites to almost all the places over the world. A customer finds it very difficult to search for the best package as he/she has to browse multiple websites, contact many travel agents and etc. which is a tedious process and is time consuming. There should be a system where the user should find the best package on the Internet with a single click.

To address this issue, we adopt Travel Guide Package Recommendation System which offers the best package among all the other packages that are on the web. This project will help tourist to suggest the best Travel Guide Package among all the package deals on the web. On multiple demands of tourist that is, a customer will select a travel guide package for a particular place based on the recommendations provided by the previous customers who had experience with the package. The Guide playing important role in the package. Therefore, according to the personalized recommendations, he/she will choose the best package that is on the web.

In Travel Guide Package Recommendation System, Admin added shareholders like tourist centre, Travel agencies, Accommodation agencies, etc. Shareholders can add their facilities and admin set as a package including price per head. Package has different categories Adventure, Family, Business, Solo, Luxury., etc. Also, customer can view all facilities, they can select one by one. After choosing the package customer can select Guide based on their rating. Guide should be registered under the branded company with experience (Local/Global area, Interacting language). Each guide is available in a particular area based on their experience and knowledge. No money ever changes hands, Only online payment. Customer pay package price to admin and admin distribute to the shareholders and guide. For each location there will be a guide so that we don’t want to take a single guide to every location. Customer can rate their guide using sentimental analysis.
1. INDRODUCTION
1.1. Problem Statement

With the increasing number of travel websites and agencies offering a wide variety of travel packages, customers face difficulty in identifying the best deal that matches their needs. Tourists must spend significant time browsing multiple websites, contacting travel agents, and comparing services. Additionally, customers lack trusted guidance in choosing packages, especially with varied guide availability, accommodation quality, and service reliability. This leads to confusion, higher costs, and dissatisfaction. Hence, there is a need for an intelligent recommendation system that consolidates packages, guides, and facilities, and provides personalized suggestions based on user preferences and previous customer feedback.
1.2. Objectives
The main objectives of the Travel Guide Package Recommendation System are:
To design a platform that integrates travel agencies, tourist centers, accommodation providers, and guides into a single recommendation system.
To recommend the best travel packages to customers based on multiple criteria such as budget, location, category, and previous customer reviews.
To allow customers to select guides based on their ratings, expertise, and language skills.
To provide a secure online payment system where customers pay the admin, who distributes funds among stakeholders.
To implement sentiment analysis for customer feedback to ensure improved recommendations over time.
To reduce customer effort by offering a one-click solution for choosing suitable travel packages.
1.3. System Overview
The Travel Guide Package Recommendation System acts as a mediator between customers and travel stakeholders
Admin: Registers stakeholders (travel agencies, accommodations, guides), manages package creation, and handles payments.
Shareholders: Travel agencies and accommodation providers add their services which are bundled into packages by the admin
Customer: Views, compares, and selects packages according to preferences (adventure, family, luxury, etc.), chooses a guide, and completes secure payment.
Guide: Provides on-location assistance to customers based on expertise and is rated by tourists.
The system uses recommendation algorithms (collaborative filtering and sentiment analysis of reviews) to suggest the best packages
2. System Study
Existing System: Customers manually browse different travel websites, compare deals, and contact agents individually. This is time-consuming, lacks transparency, and does not ensure the best package.

Proposed System: An intelligent web-based platform that aggregates all packages, facilities, and guides. Customers receive personalized recommendations, select their preferred options, and pay securely in one place.
5. System Specification
Hardware Requirements:
Processor: Intel i5 or higher
RAM: 8 GB or above
Storage: 500 GB HDD / 256 GB SSD
Network: Stable internet connection
Software Requirements:
Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React/Angular
Backend: Python (Django/Flask) or Java (Spring Boot)
Database: MySQL / PostgreSQL
Payment Gateway: PayPal/Stripe Integration
Sentiment Analysis: Python (NLTK/TextBlob)
6. Feasibility Study
Technical Feasibility: Technologies required (web frameworks, databases, sentiment analysis tools) are readily available.
Economic Feasibility: Cost-effective since most technologies are open-source; only server and hosting charges are needed.
Operational Feasibility: Easy-to-use system with an intuitive interface ensures customers and stakeholders can operate it without specialized training.
Legal Feasibility: Must comply with travel regulations, guide licensing, and online payment security laws (PCI-DSS).
7. Database Tables
a. Users Table
| UserID | Name | Email | Password | Role (Admin/Customer/Guide) | Contact |
b. Packages Table
| PackageID | Title | Category | PricePerHead | Description | ShareholderIDs |
c. Shareholders Table
| ShareholderID | Name | Type (Travel Agency/Accommodation) | Contact | Services |
d. Guide Table
| GuideID | Name | Experience | Languages | Rating | Location |
e. Customer Selection Table
| SelectionID | CustomerID | PackageID | GuideID | PaymentStatus |
f. Reviews Table
| ReviewID | CustomerID | GuideID | PackageID | Rating | Feedback | SentimentScore |
g. Payment Table
| PaymentID | CustomerID | Amount | PaymentMode | Status | Date |
